title.zh: AI模型Jev初创公司TypeSafe AI完成约8.7亿美元融资，a16z领投
title.en: AI模型Jev初创公司TypeSafe AI完成约8.7亿美元融资，a16z领投

current_state.zh: TypeSafe AI, developer of the Jev decision-execution model, closed roughly $870M in funding led by Andreessen Horowitz with Sequoia participating, valuing the 20-person startup at $7.5B as it scales deployment, hiring, and compute.
